tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand neutral. Main page background (~44% of a layout). Text on it: night (18.1:1) or ultramarine (8.0:1) only.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Body text, dark blocks and the hard offset shadow (~22%). Text on it: paper (18.1:1) or chartreuse (14.3:1) only.

tokens.name: chartreuse
tokens.usage: Primary. Buttons, key shapes and large colour blocks (~22%). Text on it: night (14.3:1) or ultramarine (6.3:1) only.

tokens.name: ultramarine
tokens.usage: Secondary, the complementary hue. Supporting blocks, cards and illustrations (~11%). Text on it: paper or chartreuse only.

tokens.name: paper-tint
tokens.usage: Subtle tint of paper for inset panels, tags and disabled fills. Night text only.

tokens.name: chartreuse-tint
tokens.usage: Light tint of chartreuse for quiet highlight backgrounds. Night text only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alias: default surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Alias: default text on surface (18.1:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias: primary action fill, with night text (14.3:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Alias: links and inline emphasis on paper (8.0:1); also the focus ring.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Backend and fullstack engineer building games and the systems behind them.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Angular and NgRx Signals, shipped end to end.

styles.name: body-bold
styles.sample: Bold for a key phrase, not a whole paragraph.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags, metadata. All lowercase (text-transform: lowercase), about 0.84× body.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The pixel unit: motif squares, tight stacks, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding, card inner gaps, mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing, page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything structural: cards, panels, image frames, tags.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs: softly rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sticker
tokens.usage: Emphasis stickers.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round avatars. The logo's quarter-circles are drawn, not radius-based.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows: solid night, no blur. No borders anywhere; the shadow is the edge.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Resting buttons, cards, panels, tags, image frames.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-lift
tokens.usage: Hover: the item moves up-left 2px and the shadow grows to match.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Pressed and disabled states.

motion.note: Wipe style. Applies to entrances, hover and the ambient loop.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: All transitions and animations.

tokens.name: duration
tokens.usage: Entrances and hover transitions.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between items in a group entrance.

tokens.name: breathe-period
tokens.usage: Ambient loop on logo and motifs: scale 1→1.04, rotate 0→-2deg.

tokens.name: hover-lift
tokens.usage: Hover moves the item up-left 2px; the hard shadow grows 5px→7px.

assets.note: Binary assets live in the design system artifact; logo SVGs are reproduced in README.md.
